title: Cancel UPI AutoPay in PhonePe: Remove or Pause (2026)
metaDescription: Stop a UPI AutoPay mandate in PhonePe: open AutoPay under Payment Management, tap Pause or Remove AutoPay, then confirm with your UPI PIN.
h1: How do you stop or pause UPI AutoPay in PhonePe?
summary: To stop a UPI AutoPay mandate in PhonePe, tap your profile picture on the home screen, open AutoPay under Payment Management, select the mandate and tap Remove AutoPay. PhonePe's help article also mentions a Pause option, but labels differ between app versions. Removing a mandate in PhonePe stops future debits but does not end your subscription with the merchant, so cancel there too.

steps.name: Tap your profile picture
steps.text: On the PhonePe home screen, tap your profile picture at the top of the screen.

steps.name: Open AutoPay
steps.text: Scroll to the Payment Management section and tap AutoPay. Some versions place it under Payments Settings or AutoPay Settings instead.

steps.name: Select the mandate
steps.text: Tap the AutoPay you want to stop. Check the merchant name and amount before you continue, so you do not stop the wrong one.

steps.name: Choose Pause or Remove
steps.text: Tap Pause if it is offered and you may want the service back. To end the mandate, tap Remove AutoPay. Some versions show Delete AutoPay, which does the same job.

steps.name: Confirm with your UPI PIN
steps.text: Enter your UPI PIN to confirm the change.

steps.name: Check the status
steps.text: Reopen AutoPay and check that the mandate shows as paused or is no longer listed as active. If the status has not changed after a few minutes, contact PhonePe support.

stepsHeading: How to remove or pause AutoPay in PhonePe

sections.heading: Where PhonePe keeps AutoPay
paragraphs: PhonePe keeps AutoPay mandates behind your profile icon. PhonePe's help article on AutoPay authorised for external merchant platforms describes the route as profile picture, then AutoPay under Payment Management, then Remove AutoPay. Other PhonePe help content uses Payments Settings and AutoPay Settings, so the wording may not match your screen exactly.

PhonePe's help article also says you can cancel the AutoPay from the merchant's own app or website, by logging in there and choosing the option to delete the AutoPay. This is useful if the merchant's app gives you a clearer view of the subscription. Whichever route you take, check the mandate in PhonePe afterwards.

sections.heading: Pause or remove: which one to choose
paragraphs: Remove AutoPay ends the mandate. If you want the service back later, you will need to set up the AutoPay again when you join or restart the subscription. Pause is the gentler option if it appears for your mandate, and it suits a short break or a seasonal service.

Sources disagree on whether PhonePe offers Pause on every version. PhonePe's help article mentions it, but some third-party guides say PhonePe only lets you delete. If Pause is not on your screen, removal is the only option in the app, so decide before you tap.

sections.heading: What happens to the next debit
paragraphs: Stopping an AutoPay in PhonePe stops future debits from that mandate. Amounts already debited are not reversed by the app. Third-party guides say a refund for a debit that has already gone through has to come from the merchant.

A debit that is already scheduled can still go through. Third-party guides say that if the next payment is only a few days away, it may already be queued, so cancelling may only stop the cycles after it. Check the next debit date in the mandate details first. If the date is close, also contact the merchant and ask them to skip the next charge.

sections.heading: Problems that stop the change
paragraphs: The most common problem is that AutoPay does not appear in the menu. Third-party guides say older versions of PhonePe may not show the mandate management options, and updating the app usually fixes this. If the mandate was created in another UPI app, it may not appear in PhonePe, so check that app as well.

Some loan and EMI mandates cannot be cancelled from the UPI app, because the lender can set them up that way. In that case, contact the lender. If PhonePe will not update the status, use the Help section in the app or contact PhonePe support. The NPCI UPI Help portal at upihelp.npci.org.in is meant to let you view, pause or revoke UPI AutoPay mandates across apps, which helps when one app will not complete the change.

sections.heading: Stopping the subscription and linked billing
paragraphs: Removing the mandate in PhonePe does not cancel the subscription itself. Cancel the service in the merchant's app or website. If the same service is billed through Google Play or the App Store instead of UPI, cancel it in that store's subscription settings. A card that the merchant keeps on file needs to be stopped with the merchant or your card issuer.
Once you have cancelled everywhere, wait for the next billing date to pass without a charge before you consider the job done. That is the clearest sign the stop has worked.

sections.heading: How tracking renewals in Essara helps
paragraphs: Essara's UPI AutoPay tracker is manual. You add each mandate yourself, with its amount and frequency, and Essara shows the auto-debits due this week and this month. It does not connect to PhonePe or your bank, and it never asks for your UPI PIN. Keeping every PhonePe mandate in one list makes it easier to spot one you forgot about, but the pause or removal still happens inside PhonePe.

faqs.q: Can I pause AutoPay in PhonePe?
faqs.a: PhonePe's help article describes a Pause option next to Remove AutoPay. Some third-party guides say the app only offers deletion, so if you do not see Pause on your version, removal is the only in-app choice. Check the label on your own screen before you tap.

faqs.q: Does removing AutoPay in PhonePe get my money back?
faqs.a: No. Removing a mandate stops future debits but does not reverse amounts that were already paid. Ask the merchant about any refund, and contact PhonePe support if you believe a debit was not authorised.

faqs.q: Why does my AutoPay still show after I removed it?
faqs.a: The status can take a few minutes to update. If the mandate still shows as active after that, check whether a debit was already scheduled, then contact PhonePe support with the mandate details and a screenshot.

faqs.q: Can I stop PhonePe AutoPay from the merchant's side instead?
faqs.a: Yes. PhonePe's help article says you can log in to the merchant's app or website and delete the AutoPay there. Afterwards, check PhonePe to confirm the mandate is no longer active.
